done_when: After an accepted sign-off, forge next leads with the step that starts the build, shows no keeps-breaking line for problems noted before the sign-off, and the sign-off result says the app constitution comes next

known.title: Preserve the next action for an existing constitution fix

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - run `forge next` again after starting the constitution fix.
Prepending `build` unconditionally makes `forge fix start "Write the prototype plan"` outrank the existing fix's work, close, or merge action until the constitution lands. `machine_next` selects only the first Next line, and `fix_start` automatically numbers duplicate names (`src/forge/task.py:646`), so following the recommendation creates additional fixes instead of progressing the first one. This also contradicts the existing command-level assertion at `tests/test_app_constitution.py:140`, which requires `next --json` to recommend working on the fix just started. Preserve that continuation when prioritizing the build step.
